evidence:
Row 31 source review found no collection-sampling or legitimate-side-effect defect after reading all 133 Functional, 4 Polish, 5 Visual and 2 gate criteria and their prompts. Frozen workbook Quality Checks!D32 and Internal Quality Checks!D32 match the skill quality-checks.md:131-132 whole-collection/unchanged rule. The frozen template was used as context; current qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md supplies the independent-scoring and no-hidden-requirement interpretation.

Collection scope is explicit: task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:19 requires before/after facts per row and per record; :37 exercises all nine tier/band pairs and all role outcomes, :45 inventories every distinct populated operational read family across six screens/details/receipts and all five ordinary write families, and :47 inspects all financial/lineage results for each same-target pair. Functional judge.toml:758 requires each inventoried anonymous read to return401 and bounded coverage reporting. P4 records each result before the next action (prompt.md:29-35); judge.toml:506 checks both revisions and all six economics, :542 checks both prior grants and the replacement plus zero-unit control, :551 requires all three referral-preserving action kinds, :893 checks each reversal/replacement/adjustment, and :902 compares all recorded restart data plus imported seed identity multiplicity.

Coordinated scope is equally explicit: prompt.md:55 inspects the two successors and all affected settlement families for the fully funded cycle and separately the60/40-to80/20 offset; :57 includes a four-member control and refuses a stale second member without changing either member; :61 checks identical retries, distinct overlapping member pairs and disjoint complete results. judge.toml:920 requires exactly one successor for each selected source; :992 includes the first still-valid member in the all-or-none guard; :1028 requires unique successor and movement/payment/grant/history deltas; :1037 forbids all partial loser effects; :1055 requires all old/new offers, all touched requisitions and each member receipt; :1091 and prompt.md:63 require preview/receipt reads for every supplied role. The shared-storage gate compares exactly one of each of its two newly saved identities. Visual whole-surface statements are scoped to examined surfaces and the prompt lists all six views plus available form/detail surfaces; Polish retention compares the full entered member selections/destinations/terms rather than one sampled member.

Preservation guards are scoped to business effects: functional prompt.md:19 expressly allows generic access/security logging after rejection and ordinary extra audit entries after actions, forbidding exact global counts. P9 at :45 repeats that exception. judge.toml:965 permits the preview draft and access logs to grow; :992 compares the state immediately BEFORE the stale attempt, so the valid intervening revision is not mistaken for a forbidden effect. judge.toml:893 permits new correction entries while retaining historical fields; the explicit SUPERSEDED/current status expectations avoid freezing legitimate lineage changes. These match public hireops_rules.md:467-472, which allows generic access logs and retained conflicted drafts.

Counterexample attempts: a weak app that settles only the first batch member, gives the losing raced offer a grant, duplicates the second member's referral, or protects one read family while leaking another cannot satisfy the quoted per-member, complete-effect and per-family bars. A conforming app that appends denial/access events or retains a conflicted preview is allowed by the global and local exceptions; extra generic logs are not duplicate successful settlements. These are source-level counterexample analyses, not measured judge outcomes.

Supporting raw observations were read with hashes verified against the current index: local/batch-domain.cjs SHA25680eb13e01fc5d9bb9514bec35721a8c0619dd1eda75c6ed6a48be8c5858a2f0d iterates receipt members at44 and48-54, compares complete financial collections at29/41/92, and checks retry counts at62-64. local/batch-witnesses/golden/results.json SHA2560c7f4da8fdc1037091fda6b28f5f2211f0ab1dfef0e1d7f2fb03c53c617d8af1 records15 passing local HTTP groups; its four source hashes were independently matched to the frozen index.js/rules.js/change-sets.js/db.js. local/batch-boundaries.cjs SHA256344a25251070ba409389a5793db93a1097d0c83ccf945c119485d9900edb5a48:33-44 checks different source-pair overlap and all six non-Finance readers/denials; results.json SHA256c952107a112b632f9282741a5b219f118a44e9e3cf5e2be4f927868ee8514bc8 reports those finite checks passing. These application-specific drivers do not establish all allowed alternative implementations or configured-judge behavior. No new Docker/provider run, deterministic private-checker execution, full judge duration, Oracle/model score or portal pass is claimed. Row31 is a semantic verifier review; other rows own required configured runtime measurements.
